title: Fix Load rejecting resources whose script inherits a global class

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Fixes #66987

In the inspector, using **Load** on a resource property rejects a resource whose script has no `class_name` but extends a script that does (one example is `apple.gd` extends `Item`), with "The selected resource (Resource) does not match any type expected for this property (Item)." Dragging the same file onto the property from the FileSystem dock works.

## Root Cause

`EditorResourcePicker::_file_selected()` checks the loaded resource's type by looking up the class name of its script's own path with `script_class_get_name()`. A script without a `class_name` has none, so the check falls back to the native type (`Resource`) and fails for an `Item` property.

Drag-and-drop goes through `_is_drop_valid()`, which uses `get_object_custom_type_name()` instead. That walks up the base scripts until it finds a named class, so it finds `Item`. The two paths have differed since the script class check was added to Load in #62413.

## Symptoms

- Loading such a resource into an `Item` property, or into an element of an `Array[Item]` property, shows the error above and leaves the property unchanged
- Drag-and-drop of the same resource is accepted
- Adding a `class_name` to the inheriting script works around it

## Additional information

When the existing check fails for a resource with a script, `_file_selected()` now also compares the class found by `get_object_custom_type_name()` against each allowed type, the same lookup `_is_drop_valid()` uses. It only adds matches, so nothing that could be loaded before is rejected now.

- It doesn't reuse `is_resource_allowed()`, because that checks against the allowed types *with* conversions (as an example.. `Texture2D` for material slots). Drag-and-drop converts those, but Load assigns the resource as-is, so it would put a raw texture into a material property.
- Empty entries in the type hint are skipped. Otherwise a hint like `"Other,"` would match any resource whose scripts have no class name, since both names would be empty.
- Not covered: the Quick Load list still doesn't show these resources, since it filters on cached file metadata (#113177, #85775), and the picker's Paste option has a similar check.
- #68035 tried to unify these checks earlier, but was closed as superseded by #71683, which didn't change the Load path.

I didn't add a unit test, since the editor's test suite can't create an `EditorNode`.

Tested on master with the issue's MRP (Load into `item` and into an `items` element is now accepted and saved.. drag-and-drop and the `class_name` case are unchanged), and with equivalent projects on 4.7, 4.6 and 4.5.

**AI disclosure:** I designed the test plan, wrote, and reviewed the changes. Opus was used for initial research and localized testing.
